annotation.authors_or_issuer: Dong, J.; Mitchell, J.J.; Yu, S.; Harmon, M.; Holstein, A.; Shim, J.H. et al.
annotation.summary_en: HRI '24 companion paper describing a nine-week robot theater afterschool program at a low-income US elementary school using social robots and AI tools for STEAM education. It explores children's views on AI/robot ethics; children showed excitement and empathy toward robots and thought developers should be responsible for harms like bullying.
key_provisions_or_claims: Nine-week afterschool program with 30 children used robots such as Pepper, NAO, Milo, Moxie and Aibo.
Children's interest in STEAM and learning increased based on observations.
Children expressed empathy and emotional attachment toward robots.
Children thought developers should be responsible for negative situations like bullying.
Program expands knowledge of AI/robot ethics in early education.
annotation.title_clean: Promoting STEAM Education and AI/Robot Ethics in a Child-Robot Theater Afterschool Program
annotation.title_en: Promoting STEAM Education and AI/Robot Ethics in a Child-Robot Theater Afterschool Program
annotation.venue: HRI '24 Companion (ACM/IEEE International Conference on Human-Robot Interaction)
